ideas.topic: The Hidden Sound of Ancient Egypt
ideas.hook: This is the only tomb in Egypt that acts like a megaphone for the dead.
ideas.why: It leverages the high curiosity factor of 'auditory' ancient artifacts, similar to the popular 'mummy you can hear' trend, while maintaining your cinematic, educational tone.

ideas.why: It builds on the success of your top-performing Khufu bureaucrat video by framing ancient engineering through a relatable, modern-day 'work/management' lens.

ideas.hook: Everyone says the Great Sphinx was shaped by thousands of years of rain, but the geology tells a different story.
